if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[ROUTINES] where SPECIFIC_SCHEMA = 'integration' and SPECIFIC_NAME = 'GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId') begin EXEC('CREATE FUNCTION [integration].[GetObjectIDByAssetTypeId] ( @id int ) RETURNS int AS BEGIN DECLARE @o int
SELECT @o = [ObjectID] from AssetType where ID = @id
RETURN @o END') end
